ruleDefinitions.name: Addition of SID History to Active Directory Object
ruleDefinitions.description: An attacker can use the SID history attribute to gain additional privileges. Note: Unmapped fields: SidHistory

sequences.query: (event_id = 4765 OR event_id = 4766) OR (event_id = 4738 AND  NOT ((SidHistory = "\-" OR SidHistory = "\%\%1793")) AND  NOT (SidHistory = "None"))
